summary: The candidate has to decide whether criticism of an advance draft warrants changing the speech.
realLife: Murphy recalled aides calling a meeting after journalists criticized a released campaign speech and Truman deciding to keep the prepared text.
inGame: needs: released copy and the specific criticism.

turns.pulledBy: The criticism concerns the speech's approach.
turns.what: The candidate hears the objection and keeps the text.
turns.writesBack: The press copy and delivered remarks can agree.

turns.pulledBy: The criticism identifies a factual mistake.
turns.what: Staff check it and issue a correction if warranted.
